rule: A type variable resolves to its declared bound
source: KNOWN_GAP: type variables are used as type names instead of their bounds
notes: call_type convention (SPEC names the six call_types but does not define direct vs method): a call with no written receiver is direct; a call with a written receiver (obj., this., super., a type name) is method; new/super(...)/this(...) are constructor. Field `current` is declared T where class Renderer<T extends Widget>; parameter `s` is declared S where <S extends Widget>. Each resolves to its bound Widget, so Widget#draw, high — not `T#draw` / `S#draw`. Type arguments are dropped from Renderer's ID (Generic/template type arguments are dropped from every ID).
